'''Kith Kark's lightsaber''' was a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] owned by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kith Kark]]. It was lost on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] following Kark's death. About [[3627 BBY|370 years later]], it was considered a valuable historical artifact, being recovered and taken to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR" />
